tex_content.html:
Proposition
[Properties of the Unit Tangent Bundle] 1. ch2:2.9If $(M,g)$ is a Riemannian manifold with or without boundary, then $UTM$ is a smooth properly embedded codimension-$1$ submanifold with boundary in $TM$, with $\partial (UTM)=\pi ^{-1}(\partial M)$. It is connected exactly when $M$ is connected, and compact exactly when $M$ is compact.
